notes.title: A New Era Begins – [Anomaly Protocol v2.5] Is Live!
notes.content:
[p]🧪 [b]What's new in Version 2.5?[/b] First, I've solidified the game's foundations and significantly improved the in-game AI and lab environments.  With the 2.5 update, I've managed to achieve a truly polished gameplay experience by fixing a total of 90 bugs.  I've recreated the in-game levels from scratch and completely overhauled the monster AI and quota objectives. The v2.5 update offers a much smoother gameplay experience and more in-game details. 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588891/f3fe7402745951b64f35164a040d3255a48f3176.png"][/img]

[b]NEW features arriving with the v2.5 update:[/b]

[b]Anomaly Inventory[/b] ⚠️: If an item in your inventory shows a red exclamation mark "!", it could be a dangerous item. This doesn't mean you have to drop it immediately, but it does mean you should be careful. 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588891/4dcefe8f4223d71b930d9a99a24a4a47e3614dbd.png"][/img]-----
[b]Siren Sounds[/b] 🔊: The siren sounds you hear in the game indicate that you have entered the most dangerous moment of the game. For an average of 1 minute, your environment becomes a very dangerous place, and you can be exposed to many anomalies. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588891/ef3cc41e562a19f1ad51f6d54baa8ef1ee6c91c1.png"][/img]-----
[b]Oxygen[/b] 💨: You must constantly monitor your oxygen level in the game. You can refill your oxygen tank from the oxygen tanks you find in the game. ⛽
[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588891/1c4b5c2ac4f8ab5b975ceee39ceae1adbcf64160.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588891/9fe862ce8d7ecd2cab68f3ec52ca86a523d2f227.png"][/img][/carousel][p]

-----
[b]MiniGame[/b] 🧩: There are many doors and many rooms in the game! So when you don't have a key, you can win one by playing this mini-game. 🔑 [b]However[/b], this game becomes increasingly difficult. As you play, the game will get harder, and if you fail, the game will kill you. 💀 Finally, you can only play this game 10 times, so use your key resources wisely! 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588891/323de34a813fee021e1077bb650df88bc8815d64.png"][/img]------
[b]Storage[/b] 📦: The storage is your in-game depot where you stock items. Every item you place in this area is visible to all players, and you can see how many items you have in the storage. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588891/947c65f12662b3d768b3ace1dd9785356b5ab630.png"][/img]-----

[b]Quota[/b] 📈: The game quota will increase with every day you spend in the game, and the number of anomalies will increase each day. 👾

[b]Revive Your Dead Friend[/b] 👻[/p][p]When your friend dies in the game, you have two options to revive them:[/p][list][*][p][b]1. AnomalyBaby[/b] : This is an in-game item that looks like you. By taking this item to the revival room and placing it inside the revival capsule, your friend will be revived. ♻️[/p][/*][*][p][b]2. Quota Completion[/b] : The second method is to complete the quota given to you in the game. When you complete it and get on the elevator, all your dead friends will be automatically revived. 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588891/6ed08da8fb32fafd576bcdc3c6c27712a11ddd10.png"][/img]
[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update Notes v2.2 (New Features and Fixes)
notes.content:
[b]-- NEW FEATURES --[/b]

1- A very sneaky entity that constantly watches you has been added to the game! (Update the game to see it).

2- An oxygen system has been introduced to the game! Now, the higher your radiation level, the faster your oxygen will decrease.

To replenish your oxygen in the game, you must find oxygen tanks and place them in the oxygen station.

Your oxygen can deplete very quickly! So, constantly check the radiation value of the room you are in! Remember: the further you get from the entrance when you go down, the harder it will be to return!

3- The key-earning minigame within the game has been further improved. Note: the minigame is now only 10 rounds, so use your keys carefully! Keys are very important in the game.

4- If you successfully complete the quota after all your friends have died in the game, all your friends will respawn.

5- You will now be able to see the "Sales Quota" in every level.

You can now see how many items have been sold in each level without going to the sales area; you can see it in the top right corner of your screen.

6- You can now turn on the lights in the rooms yourself. (You can leave the lights on in the rooms you pass through to better understand which rooms you've been in and to avoid getting lost, thus preventing time loss).

[b]-- Bugs and Fixes --[/b]

1- When generating dungeon rooms, they would sometimes overlap. Rooms and walls have been 98% fixed.

2- The issue of falling out of the elevator has been 95% fixed (if your ping is very high, you may still sometimes fall from the elevator).

3- The issue where players would see monsters and items in different locations has been fixed.

4- The quota and item counts in each level were not balanced, making some levels impossible to complete. The item placements in the game have been completely rearranged.

5- The game environment was too dark; lighting has been added.
